Effect: [Your Turn][Once per Turn] When a green Tamer card would be played from your hand, by suspending 1 of your green Digimon, reduce the play cost by 3.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve, if you have a green Tamer, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
Notes: 2024 Championship Regionals Finalist Card Set Wave 1
